breakdown.rationale: Both physical accessibility (braille-inscribed elevators, ramps, touchless entry, wheelchair-accessible restrooms) and a digital/assistive measure (text-to-speech software for visually impaired employees) are disclosed with specific detail, though coverage is only 'most premises' and no accessibility audit or conformance standard is cited.
breakdown.recommendation: Publish the percentage of sites/offices meeting full accessibility standards and any accessibility audit results.

breakdown.rationale: An Equal Opportunity Policy aligned to the RPwD Act, 2016, plus Code of Conduct and DEI Policy references to disability non-discrimination are disclosed, but no concrete accommodation request/approval process is described.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe the concrete process by which a PwD employee requests and receives a workplace accommodation.

breakdown.rationale: Specific headcounts are disclosed (3 differently abled employees, 15 differently abled workers, with gender breakdown), but no percentage of total workforce or multi-year trend is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD headcount as a percentage of total workforce and track it over time.

breakdown.rationale: No PwD-specific recruitment targets, disability-focused outreach programs, or hiring attainment figures are disclosed anywhere in the filing.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose any disability-specific hiring targets or outreach programs and report attainment against them.

breakdown.rationale: General permanent-employee/worker turnover rates are disclosed but not broken out for PwD employees specifically.
breakdown.recommendation: Report attrition and tenure data specifically for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: 'Specially abled' diversity is listed only as a general 2030 diversity goal category alongside gender and regional diversity; the only performance KPI reported against it is gender diversity in executives, with no PwD-specific leadership representation data.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD representation specifically within senior/management roles.

breakdown.rationale: A specific training type is named (Indian Sign Language training to assist communication with deaf and mute colleagues) plus a diversity/inclusion sensitisation workshop, but no participation numbers or coverage rates are disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Report participation/completion rates for disability sensitization and sign-language training.

breakdown.rationale: No ongoing PwD-specific culture practices (ERG, flexible work arrangements, accommodation response-time commitments) are disclosed beyond general policy statements.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose ongoing culture practices supporting PwD employees, such as a dedicated employee resource group.

breakdown.rationale: General grievance redressal mechanisms (Grievance Redressal Committees, Sampark CEO townhall, Vigil Mechanism) are described, but none are disability-specific and no PwD satisfaction data is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose satisfaction or grievance-resolution data specific to PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: The filing does not state RPwD Act quota attainment as a percentage or claim any accessibility conformance standard (e.g. WCAG level); only general policy-alignment language is used.
breakdown.recommendation: State the RPwD Act statutory quota attainment percentage or any formal accessibility conformance standard achieved.
